sources.entry: SilverBullet - Note-taking application optimized for people with a hacker mindset. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) MIT Docker/Deno

summary.one_liner: SilverBullet is a self-hosted, browser-based Markdown note-taking app with wiki-style linking and Lua scripting, described as a programmable personal knowledge database.
summary.what_it_does: Stores notes as a collection of Markdown pages (called a Space) and provides a live-preview editor. Pages are navigated through a page picker or through bi-directional wiki-style links. It includes outlining tools, tasks, and a built-in database with objects and a query language (SLIQ). Space Lua, a Lua dialect, is used to generate content dynamically and to define custom commands, page templates, and widgets. The frontend is TypeScript on CodeMirror 6 with Preact, and the server is written in Rust and includes a headless-Chrome runtime for server-side Lua.
use_cases: querying structured notes as a database
scripting custom commands and templates in Lua
notable: Space Lua scripting for dynamic content, commands, templates and widgets
Bi-directional wiki-style links combined with a page picker
Plug system with a plug compiler and published plug-api to NPM
Runnable via Docker container without local Node.js or Rust
caveats: Development setup requires Node.js 24+, npm 10+, and Rust stable via rustup
Server-side Lua depends on a headless-Chrome runtime
